Enjoyed their Dutch truffle, pineapple pastry and walnut browny. Spicy chicken and paneer Puffs were okay.

featured_reviews.name: Neha Speaks
featured_reviews.review_text: They make decent pastries. It’s clean and the pastries are fresh. I even purchased bread and some cookies, they were delicious.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Updated review as of 9/11/24: I have eaten almost everything from here and I do not recommend this place anymore. It has further fallen in quality and everything is just too dry. It's just not worth it, taste and price wise. Unless there's a massive overhaul, i'd avoid this place :(

Old review: Ate two different brownies and found them a little sweet for my taste buds, store is very aesthetic and staff were friendly enough.

featured_reviews.name: Anand Priya Deo
featured_reviews.review_text: One of the best bakeries 🥯 in the city no doubt! I have used their bread, croissants and wall nut cake and I must say all of them met my expectations. I got disappointed with their fruit juice made of Mango. First of all that was super expensive and the worst in quality. I will recommend not to have juice at this place as ut is not their forte.

featured_reviews.name: The Glocal Journal
featured_reviews.review_text:
I really like theobroma for its kind of chocolate. Also they use good authentic ingredients.

And everyone knows how good is their brownie.

However I am disappointed with a few things.
Firstly their half kg cake is extremely small as compared to any other cake shop. I find it  surprising. And no, it's not that it has a great height that the breadth is tiny. It is just average.

Secondly, their Cappuccino is synonymous to water.

Thirdly, almost at all their outlets the chocolate mousse is always stocked out.

Not denying that yes some of the products are great, but somethings can definitely worked on.

featured_reviews.name: Preeti Suri
featured_reviews.review_text:
Went to this place to buy their brownies which are so famous and yum. Located on main Linking road... This place has the yummiest cakes and some evening snacks.
Good place to chill out in the evenings with family or friends.
You should try their Rye bread, which comes when the store opens in the morning and is sold then... Always sold off... It really is healthy and tastes good.
Recently they came up with Rasin and Rum Brownie which tastes bet good.
Parking is not available and seating is also an issue as it's crowded in evening.
Over all my all time favourite store.

featured_reviews.name: Parvez Meherhomji
featured_reviews.review_text: Always a good place to visit, I'm in love with their Monday BOGO offers. It helps that it is a 4 min walk at max from my office. My go-to food item here is the quiche. Veg or chicken, both will delight. The brownies are excellent. Any food you order here, you can be assured on the quality aspect; it's really good. If you haven't already been here a 100+ times, what are you waiting for? 😜

review_photos.caption: The chicken quiche. One of the best savoury items this city has to offer. Seriously underrated.

featured_reviews.name: Mansi Abnave
featured_reviews.review_text: I was so happy that we now have Theobroma in borivali. I love everything they have on their menu. Specially cheesecakes and brownies. Ohh they are so yummy, mouthwatering, and honestly after try theobroma, its my fix place if i have sweet tooth. Their millionaire brownie is the best brownie I've ever tried. I mean i love all their cheesecakes. If you go there, service is amazing, i like how they've decorated the place in pastel colours and i love their seating arrangements also. Overall cute ambience. And I've tried ordering also when i dont want to go out but have some comfort food. And delivery is fast, packaging is sooo cute, i love theobroma. Would recommend to everyone cause its worth you guys.

featured_reviews.name: Jewel Dsz
featured_reviews.review_text: ​"Love the vibe at this location! They have a fantastic display of fresh cakes and cupcakes. Tried the Carrot Cupcake and the Chocolate Pistachio Cheesecake—both were 10/10. The cheesecake is very rich and perfect for sharing. Staff named Min Min was humble and very helpful and the store was clean and inviting. Will definitely be back to try the banana pudding next! 🍰☕"

featured_reviews.name: Prithu
featured_reviews.review_text: Magnolia Bakery is exactly the kind of café that instantly puts you in a good mood. The space is bright, spotless, and has that comforting bakery charm that makes you want to try everything on display. The selection of sweets and desserts is outstanding, and it is genuinely difficult to make a bad choice here. Every item looks as good as it tastes, which is rare. Whether you are craving something rich, light, or indulgent, this place delivers effortlessly. An absolute must visit if you are anywhere near the area.

featured_reviews.name: Tanisha V. Poddar
featured_reviews.review_text:
We visited Magnolia bakery after seeing a hundreds of reels on Instagram.
It’s a cute bakery shop located in bandra which has spacious and comfortable seating.
Ther service is very quick.
They have a large variety of desserts including both eggless and egg.
We tired their classic viral tres leches, which is good in taste but personally i wouldn’t prefer to order it next time.
Next we tried its chocolate pudding parfait which is a must try for people who love dark chocolate flavour. I loved its taste, it had a good amount of chocolate cake and ice cream.
We even ordered its chocolate cupcake and oh my god the sponge was so soft and fluffy, One bite and it melts in your mouth, even the cream layer on top is amazing.
Lastly tired it’s chocolate cheesecake which was ok in taste, i have had better cheesecake.

Overall we satisfied our midnight dessert craving.

featured_reviews.name: Kas
featured_reviews.review_text:
Me and my best friend had been wanting to go to Magnolia Bakery for the longest time, and when we finally visited — it was 100% worth the wait ✨

We tried the tres leches, and oh my god… hands down the best tres leches in the city. The first bite literally melted in our mouths. It’s so soft, perfectly soaked, not overly sweet — just pure dessert perfection. And it hits the same with every single bite.

If you’re in Bombay, this is a must-try, must-have, don’t-skip dessert spot 💕

featured_reviews.name: Harkirat Bagga
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Magnolia Bakery and tried the red velvet cake and chocolate pudding parfait.
The red velvet cake was soft, moist, and nicely balanced with cream cheese frosting.
The chocolate pudding parfait was rich&creamy
Overall a great place.

featured_reviews.name: The Dhwalin
featured_reviews.review_text:
Good in taste, best atmosphere. Better to go in taxi as parking issue is there. Park on your own risk.

Tried two items and both were so delicious. Classic Tres leches Cake was so smooth, creamy, best for sweet tooth people.

Mango Pudding Parfait was something new but FYI, it has grated dry coconut. 🥥 but it is lovely combination, mix well before eating.

Could not get a chance to sit inside as I was in car and no parking was there otherwise sit & eat is preferable.

featured_reviews.name: Saleel Kurane
featured_reviews.review_text: Magnolia Bakery totally lives up to the hype. The pastries are perfectly creamy, not too sweet, and honestly addictive. The cupcakes are soft, flavorful, and beautifully decorated, and everything tastes fresh. The shop itself is super cute and inviting, and the staff was friendly even when it was busy. A great spot for dessert or a sweet treat - definitely worth the stop!

featured_reviews.name: Viraj Mali
featured_reviews.review_text: Super friendly staff and probably the best bakery in Bandra. Tried the classis Tres Leches and it exceeded our expectations. Surely will visit again. Lots of options in cakes, pastries, icecream, beverages.

featured_reviews.review_text: It’s a very minimalistic place offering some really good basque cheesecakes. They had different flavors in it as well but we opted for the classic one. They also have bunch of other desserts and savory items such as puffs and pizzas. The seating is very limited though.

There Korean Cream cheese Kouign Amann and Tiramisu cube croissant are ones we enjoyed the most. multigrain sourdough is just what u need for some nice home made sandwiches. We enjoyed our afternoon very much at this outlet.

featured_reviews.name: Jwala Salim
featured_reviews.review_text: All the items were really good and fresh. Loved the hot dog roll, the pesto danish and the tomato olive mozzarella croissant.

featured_reviews.name: Simon Wile
featured_reviews.review_text: This a damn good bakery. Pastry is crunchy, flaky and not overly sweet. Fillings are flavourful and delicious. Price is reasonable for the quality. Would go back for more!

featured_reviews.name: Ishana Biju
featured_reviews.review_text: Sadly it looks so good. But tastes a bit synthetic and too sweet. None of the things I ordered swept me off my feet.  Over priced in my opinion.

featured_reviews.name: J Dredd
featured_reviews.review_text: Tried the strawberry cheesecake cube croissant here, and it was a letdown. I visited early in the morning and specifically asked if the baked goods were fresh—they assured me they were, but that clearly wasn’t the case. The texture was more like brioche than a croissant, and the cheesecake filling was bland, lacking any standout flavor. For the price, I expected much better. I’ve had phenomenal cube croissants before, but this one completely missed the mark. Definitely not worth it.

featured_reviews.name: Hussain Tinwala
featured_reviews.review_text: A cozy and aesthetic cafe with a minimal, modern vibe. The aroma of freshly baked bread and pastries welcomes you the moment you step in. Their palmiers and croissants are a must-try — perfectly flaky, buttery, and delicious. The display is filled with fresh breads, desserts, and sweet treats, all made with care and quality ingredients. Friendly staff, quick service, and a warm ambiance make it a perfect spot for coffee breaks or grabbing artisanal bakes to go.

Firstly for 1/2kg Cake which is already expensive,they dont deliver at doorstep. I ordered Nutella 1/2 kg and apart from the Nutella jar i could not taste Nutella in Cake. Keeping everything aside my cake was different from the picture that they share on Instagram and Zomato. Sad to see when brands like Melting Morsel does these kind of things. ***
Nutella Cake - 3/5
Ambience - 3/5

We tried a chocolate cupcake and a chocolate macroon here.Also tried a red velvet cupcake and fererro rocher freakshake here!

featured_reviews.name: Himanshu Jain

Coffee also excellent, and they also serve pastas, sandwiches and other light food items... Very high quality chocolate used in deserts, would strongly recommend their Soil Cake.

featured_reviews.name: Kaiarsh Saher
featured_reviews.review_text:
Crumblet is a charming new cafe in Bandra West, tucked away in the same lane as Toto’s. While it’s a small space, it truly packs a punch!

Their current menu features some delicious treats, including their signature pineapple cake and the basque cheesecake. I tried the chocolate chip cookie, and it was a perfect balance of gooey and chewy goodness.

They also offer a coffee menu, and I’m already looking forward to coming back to try more desserts and their coffee.

The seating is limited, so I recommend grabbing a spot as soon as you arrive. A cozy spot with great potential for dessert lovers in Bandra!

featured_reviews.name: Vidhi Jain

featured_reviews.name: Sarah Shaikh

I had the loveliest experience at Crumblet! Had the chocolate chip cookie and the NY style cheescake. The cookie was warm, soft, and perfectly gooey. The NY cheesecake was incredibly creamy and smooth.
What made the visit even more special was the wonderful staff. They were so sweet and welcoming.

featured_reviews.name: Ragini Chopra
featured_reviews.review_text: The vegan dessert was one of the best I have ever had. Perfect moist and not that sweet. Definitely coming back again♥️

featured_reviews.name: Ritika
featured_reviews.review_text: Just visited Crumblet and absolutely loved it! I tried the Salted Caramel Cake and the Double Chocolate Fudge Cookie, both were incredibly delicious and full of flavor. The staff was super friendly and welcoming, which made the experience even better. Definitely a place I’d come back to!

featured_reviews.name: Ganga Agarwal
featured_reviews.review_text: Crumblet truly feels like the best place in the world for dessert. There’s nothing over-the-top or fancy, just really great products made with love, and that’s what makes it so special. Every visit feels comfortable, welcoming, and consistently amazing. And on top of that, Siddhi brings such kindness and positive energy that she makes the whole experience even better. It’s the kind of place that makes you happy just being there.🥹🥰❣️⭐️❤️😇😍🌳

featured_reviews.name: Shailja Jaiswal
featured_reviews.review_text:
This place has been on my list for desserts for a very long time seeing the amazing reviews they had, and we finally went there. But the place isn’t as great as I read in the reviews.
We ordered the hot chocolate which was good but could be better, and I read in the reviews that their quality has now gone down. Though the hot chocolate was good but not at all hot, but when we requested them to reheat it they did reheat it for us. One of the servers there was really nice and swift in getting everything we requested.
They also had their strawberry specials menu and we ordered the strawberry tres leches cake which was so good, the taste was something which reminded me of childhood. The portion was huge and can be eaten by 2-3 people.
Overall a good dessert place, they don’t have any savoury items though, I think just 2-3 savoury things but it’s more of a desserts place.
The interiors are also very interesting, thought extremely small snd they don’t have a washroom or hand-wash anywhere.

featured_reviews.name: Ankur Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you’re craving indulgent hot or cold chocolate in Mumbai, Chantilly and Chantilly Works, Bandra is an absolute must-visit.

They serve one of the best strawberry chocolates and hot/cold chocolates the city has to offer. It’s clearly a favorite among many—and honestly, I completely get why.

Yes, it may seem a bit pricey at first, but the quality and experience make it totally worth it. I’d highly recommend trying their 75% dark chocolate version—rich, intense, and perfectly balanced.

A little personal ritual I swear by:
I usually order a hot chocolate, enjoy half there, and take the rest home. Refrigerate it overnight and have it cold the next day—it tastes incredible!

One thing to note: the seating space is very small—just a few tables. If you visit at night, be prepared for a wait, even for takeaway sometimes.

I’m not even a big chocolate person, but this place is an exception I happily make.

Must visit when your chocolate cravings hit! 🍫

featured_reviews.name: Sweetlin Nadar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Chantilly. The cafe itself is quite small, but it has a  cozy charm. They also have a wide variety of desserts and drinks on the menu, which makes the place exciting to try.
However, our experience was a bit mixed. The nut butter waffle and hot chocolate were extremely sweet for our liking, which made them difficult to finish. On the brighter side, the cinnamon croissant was really good and nicely balanced.
Overall, the experience wasn’t as great as we expected. It would be wonderful if they added more no-added-sugar or less-sweet dessert options for people who prefer lighter sweetness.

featured_reviews.name: Yo Day
featured_reviews.review_text: We ordered hot chocolate, frozen hot chocolate, classic cheesecake, nutella cheesecake, and brownie sundae. All of them tasted subpar except the hot chocolate, which was good - but they were out of marshmallows so we paid the same price without having marshmallows. There was a 1-1.5 hr wait for this overhype. Totally not recommended. Brownie sundae of McDonald's is far better and cheaper. And even after waiting for 1 hour we didn't get a seat inside.. trust me this is just overhyped because of instagram. Avoid.

featured_reviews.name: Kush Nagda
featured_reviews.review_text:
A must-visit for strawberry lovers! 🍓

Chantilly – The Café is an absolute delight, especially if you love strawberry desserts. Every dessert is beautifully crafted, fresh, and packed with rich, authentic strawberry flavour, not overly sweet and perfectly balanced.

The presentation is stunning, the quality is consistent, and you can tell a lot of care goes into what they serve. Pair that with a cozy ambience and warm service, and it becomes a place you’ll want to keep coming back to.

If strawberries are your thing, Chantilly – The Café is definitely worth the visit. Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: Naisha Puthran
featured_reviews.review_text: A charming little spot with a warm and cozy vibe. Chantilly is perfect for dessert lovers. The cheesecakes are absolutely delicious and one of those treats you keep going back for more. The desserts are beautifully made, and the lovely ambience makes it a perfect place to unwind over coffee and something sweet. Definitely worth visiting!

featured_reviews.name: Abhishek Das
featured_reviews.review_text: Insta hyped place but fails on all counts. A small hole in the wall outlet with barely 6-7 tables and a queue of 50-70 minute waiting for dine-in. The strawberry cheesecake at ₹485 is a big let down. The hot chocolate is overtly sweet and isn’t worth the hype at all. Go if you are one of the 100 who’d visit to get pictures and FOMO of Instagram, avoid if you truly want some good desserts and coffee / hot chocolate. Very poor. There are several other places right around the corner with far better options and without the unnecessary hype.

featured_reviews.name: Imran Memon
featured_reviews.review_text: We are convinced to go visit the cafe by a friend and we are glad we did. Amazing little cafe. Beautiful quirky ambience with really helpful servers. The toffee pudding and cookie were absolutely delicious. Highly recommend stopping by for a sweet treat!

featured_reviews.name: Murtaza Anverali
featured_reviews.review_text:
Deliciae by Bunty Mahajan: Mango Biscoff Cheesecake = Summer in a Slice*

Deliciae never misses with desserts, but the *Mango Biscoff Cheesecake* is next-level indulgence. If you think mango and Biscoff sounds risky, this will convert you.

*Presentation*: It arrives looking like art. A perfect round slice with that golden mango glaze on top, a generous dusting of Biscoff crumbs, and a caramelized Biscoff biscuit perched on the side. The layers are clean and distinct even before the first bite. You can tell it’s been set with care, not rushed.

*Taste & Texture*: This is where it becomes addictive. The base is a thick, buttery Biscoff crust that holds up without crumbling everywhere. It gives you that warm, spiced caramel note in every forkful. The cheesecake layer is insanely smooth and creamy, with a light tang that cuts through the sweetness. Then comes the mango: real Alphonso pulp, not artificial essence. It’s fresh, tropical, and balances the Biscoff beautifully so nothing feels cloying. The top glaze adds a subtle fruity brightness. Together it’s sweet, spiced, tangy, and lush.

*Overall Experience*: Each bite gives you multiple textures. Crumbly base, silky cheesecake, soft mango layer, and that little crunch from Biscoff crumbs on top. It’s rich but not heavy, and somehow feels both decadent and summery at once. Portion size is generous enough to share, though you won’t want to.

*Vibe at Deliciae*: The patisserie itself matches the dessert. Elegant, pastel, with display counters that make you want everything. Staff are super helpful and package it beautifully if you’re taking away. No soggy cheesecake disasters here.

*Verdict*: Mango + Biscoff sounds like a weird collab that should not work, but Deliciae makes it iconic. This cheesecake is indulgent, balanced, and wildly photogenic. Easily one of the best fusion desserts I have had this season.

*Pro tip*: Pair it with their cold coffee. Thank me later.

Already craving my next slice. If you’re a cheesecake or mango person, skip everything else and get this first.

5-Star Review for Deliciae By Bunty Mahajan
Absolutely Divine! The Hazelnut Divine Cake is a Masterpiece ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I ordered the 1kg Hazelnut Divine Cake from Deliciae By Bunty Mahajan as a special surprise for an amazing female trainer at the gym – a heartfelt thank you for all her motivation and hard work.

From the moment it arrived, it was clear this was no ordinary cake. The presentation was stunning: a glossy chocolate mirror glaze that shone beautifully, elegant swirls of rich chocolate rosettes, scattered roasted hazelnuts for that perfect crunch, and even a personalized plaque that made it feel extra thoughtful.

But the real magic happened when we cut into it – layers of moist vanilla sponge intertwined with generous chocolate ganache and crunchy roasted hazelnuts. Every bite was an explosion of decadent chocolate-hazelnut flavor, perfectly balanced, not overly sweet, and incredibly indulgent. It truly lived up to its “Divine” name!

This cake didn’t just taste extraordinary; it made her day truly special. Her smile and excitement said it all – it was the highlight of the gym ! At around ₹2631, it was worth every single rupee for the premium quality, freshness, and joy it brought.
Deliciae By Bunty Mahajan continues to be Mumbai’s best pâtisserie for a reason – flawless execution, timely delivery, and cakes that are as beautiful as they are delicious.

Highly recommend for any celebration or just to make someone’s day unforgettable. Thank you, team – you’ve gained a loyal customer!

featured_reviews.name: Arjika S
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Brownie Cottage at Carter Road, Bandra — and I have to say, the taste totally lived up to the hype! 😍 We ordered two gooey brownies with vanilla ice cream, topped with Nutella. They warmed the brownies before serving, and that warm-cold combo with the Nutella drizzle was chef’s kiss. Super indulgent and absolutely delicious!

BUT — it came to around ₹1100 for two brownies, so ₹550 per plate, which honestly feels way too expensive. There are other places offering a similar taste and quality for around ₹100-₹120. Yes, the dessert is premium, but the pricing could definitely be more reasonable.

So overall — amazing taste, cozy vibes, but not very pocket-friendly. Would recommend for a once-in-a-while treat, but not something I’d splurge on regularly unless the prices drop a bit.

Le 15 Patisserie has the best of cupcakes and they are worth every bite.  Recently, one of our colleagues got couple of cupcakes from Le 15 Patisserie (Bandra) and I loved it.

The outlet looks small and colourful. You can either have it or take-away.

featured_reviews.name: Nakshatra sain
featured_reviews.review_text:
| Le 15: - The magic of 'Pooja Dhingra' is totally worth the hype, must visit place if you are in Bombay |

As Pooja Dhingra says there 'Macarons' are made with love that is why they are so successful, entirely true, the macrons are different from any conventional store and better than some of the big names.

The Outlet: - Outlet is entirely pink in color, they have tried to give a french feel inside the outlet & as you will enter the outlet, you can feel it. The colorful macarons will be there to welcome you.

Must Try: -

1. Lavander Macaron: - It will steal your heart from the beginning, the color to its taste everything about it is just perfect.

2. Dark Chocolate: - It's one of there most selling Macaron.

3. Pistachio: - These are the true classic french Macarons and they have successfully delivered the French taste.

4. Coffee: - If you are a coffee lover, this will be the best thing of the day for you.

5. Red Velvet Cup Cake: - I loved the red velvet cake, it was the best among all the cakes.

Best Cakes: -

1. Belgian Chocolate cake: - This is the most selling cake of Le 15 & once you will have it you will know why? Book it for the next special occasion.

2. Macaron Cake: - Yes! For those who don't know they serve Macaron Cake as well and if you click a picture of it, will be the most beautiful & gorgeous picture on your Instagram feed.

Why I love Le 15?
The way Pooja Dhingra has created all the outlets with so much love & the way she has marketed Le 15, I am a fan of her. She is very inspirational, also created the magnum series a few days back.

| Conclusion|

If you are in Bombay rush to the outlet right now and if you are not when you visit, make it a point to visit Le 15.

P.S: -The pictures that you will click at Le 15 will be the gorgeous pictures on your Instagram Feed

featured_reviews.name: Soumyashree Patra
featured_reviews.review_text:
I was looking for a healthy vegan option in birthday cakes at short notice and hardly found anything good online. Came across Sweegan randomly and trusted the good reviews. Komal was really sweet and understanding, prompt in helping with everything needed to place the order and quick communication and responses through the day. I was able to get the cake delivered within just a few hours.
Sweegan has really great options and the coffee walnut ragi cake I ordered did not disappoint at all. The cake was pure nostalgia - homemade with love and simple personal touches. The taste and texture were amazing and we absolutely loved it. Would definitely recommend if you want a break from cream/fondant loaded cakes and looking for healthy vegan options.

featured_reviews.name: Jill Ashar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I ordered a Ragi jaggery base cake from Sweegan for my daughter's first birthday which was the most tastiest cake that we ever had my daughter really enjoyed the cake and I was guilt free while she was eating.
I also ordered chocolate orange cake from Sweegan which tastes like just amazing. 🩷 My experience with Ms. Komal has also been really good. Thank you Sweegan for making our special day more special. Highly recommend.

featured_reviews.name: Paddy Joy
featured_reviews.review_text: We have had two of their cakes this week- chocolate millet with almond topping and chocolate orange. While both were amazing, personally we loved the chocolate orange cake even more. They both felt very light on the stomach, not very sweet (which is good) completely vegan and made with healthy ingredients. What made the experience truly memorable is how easy it is communicate with Komal and how organised and meticulous and punctual she is. We also greatly appreciated that she sent toppers and a candle, it makes it all so convenient. We will surely be going back to them for more.

featured_reviews.name: ishan bhat
featured_reviews.review_text: We liked the dates and walnut cake very much, especially the walnuts on the cake. Thanks a lot for this smooth experience for cake ordering. for sure will order multiple times next

featured_reviews.name: karishma sharma
featured_reviews.review_text: I recently ordered the Dates & Walnut Cake from Sweegan for my husband's birthday, and it was absolutely delicious!! The flavors were perfectly balanced with just the right amount of natural sweetness from the dates, making it light, satisfying, and guilt-free. The texture was moist and soft, and I loved that it was made with wholesome ingredients—no refined sugars, artificial additives, or maida. I would preferred this over the icing & cream cakes going forth. I’ll definitely be ordering again and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a healthier, flavorful & beautiful looking dessert.

featured_reviews.name: am_ pranav
featured_reviews.review_text:
I ordered a mix dry fruit cake from Sweegan for my kid's 3rd birthday, and I must say it exceeded all expectations! What made this cake truly special was the use of jaggery and Ragi flour, making it not just delicious but also a healthier choice for my little one. My kid and family absolutely loved the flavor and texture, and knowing that it was made with wholesome ingredients was a bonus!

The attention to detail was amazing, especially with the customized cake toppers designed to match my kid's interests – a personal touch that made the celebration even more memorable. The cake arrived in excellent packaging, keeping it fresh and intact, ready to impress.

I highly recommend Sweegan for anyone looking for healthy, flavorful cakes that don’t compromise on quality or presentation. We'll definitely be returning customers!"

featured_reviews.name: Monish liya
featured_reviews.review_text: Finding cakes and cake premium pre mixes that are actually Nutritious, Healthy, Refined sugar Free, is actually difficult but this place has mastered the balance and tastes just amazing even youngsters or kids would love it, Their cake mixes are completely refined sugar-free, relying on high-quality ingredients like pure jaggery syrup that make you feel good about every next bite. It’s rare to find a healthy treat, but this cake which just got ready in 10mins was so spongy, rich, and flavorful. Just loved it

featured_reviews.name: Diya Rohra
featured_reviews.review_text:
Komal Ahuja's Healthy Millet Cakes are an absolute gem! The Hazelnut Chocolate Cake I recently tried was beyond delicious—it was an explosion of flavor that left me craving more. The blend of hazelnut and chocolate was simply divine, and the fact that it's made with wholesome ingredients made it even more satisfying.
For all the dark chocolate lovers, I highly suggest to opt for sugar-free dark chocolate for the toppings, it just adds feather to the hat. Whether you're health-conscious or simply looking for delicious treats that won't compromise on taste, you'll find exactly what you're looking for here.

Her sweetness extends beyond just her cakes; it's also reflected in the care and attention she puts into every aspect of it - Upon informing her that it was my dad's birthday, she immediately added a 'Super dad' ribbon that speaks volume about kindness and warmth.

Highlyy Recommend!!!

featured_reviews.review_text:
Suzette has become my go-to spot for coffee, and it’s easy to see why. The moment you walk in, the open, airy feel of the place puts you at ease — it’s the kind of café you actually want to linger in.
What really sets Suzette apart is the people. The staff are warm, attentive, and genuinely welcoming, and the owner is just as friendly — the kind of person who makes you feel like a regular from day one. Great service here isn’t an afterthought, it’s the whole vibe.
Beyond the excellent coffee, the food is well worth exploring. The sandwiches are satisfying and well-made, and the crêpes are a must-try. Whether you’re stopping in for a quick cup or settling in for a proper bite, Suzette delivers every time. Highly recommend!

featured_reviews.name: Sakshi shrivastava
featured_reviews.review_text: We visited Suzette in Bandra West for the first time, all the way from Vadodara, and had a truly wonderful experience. Though we had only ordered omelettes, the café manager, Aarif, surprised us with a complimentary cappuccino and also offered us a taste of both sweet and savoury crepes on the house. It was such a thoughtful gesture and made our visit even more special. The food was absolutely delicious, and the entire team—from the chef to the staff and manager—was incredibly warm and welcoming. We highly recommend this place for both the taste and the hospitality!

featured_reviews.name: Varun Badhwar

featured_reviews.name: amin shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you find yourself in Khar, especially around Linking Road, Khobake & Co. is an absolute must-visit! This charming little cafe is a hidden gem, offering the perfect cozy atmosphere for a chill day out. Whether you’re looking to work, unwind with a book, or just indulge in some seriously amazing treats, this place has got you covered.
From the moment you step in, the aesthetic ambiance sweeps you into a relaxing vibe. It's one of those spots where you can just feel the warmth in the air—almost like the food is made with love (which, I'm sure it is). Whether you're driving a Benz or not, the vibe here feels upscale yet super welcoming.
What we tried:
Chocolicious Shake – Decadent and rich. A chocolate lover's dream.
Vietnamese Cold Coffee – Perfectly brewed and refreshing. Definitely a must-try for coffee enthusiasts.
Korean Cheese Bun – The combination of savory cheese in a soft bun? Simply unforgettable.
Chicken Puff – Light, flavorful, and packed with goodness.
Tandoori Chicken Croissant Sandwich – A beautiful fusion of crunchy croissant and tender chicken. A game changer!
Mocha Royale – The perfect balance of coffee and chocolate. A true indulgence.
Choco Chippy Tea Cake – This was hands-down the highlight of our visit. Soft, rich, and packed with little chocolate surprises. It's a must-try!
For dessert, you cannot miss:
Signature Vintage Petit Gateau – A slice of pure heaven with the perfect texture and flavor balance.
Tropical Coconut Punch Gateau – Light and refreshing, with the tropical flavors hitting just right.
In short, Khobake & Co. is not just a cafe, it's an experience. Whether you're here for the desserts, the drinks, or just to enjoy the ambiance, you’ll leave with a full heart (and a full stomach). Highly recommend if you're in the Khar area! 🧁

featured_reviews.name: Afreen Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Hearsch Bakery early morning around 8:50 am only to realise the bakery opens at 9 am sharp (and remains closed on Tuesdays). As soon as the shutters opened, everyone waiting in the queue entered one by one and placed their orders in a very organised manner.

The uncle at the counter welcomed everyone with a warm smile and was extremely courteous. Despite the rush, our order was prepared within 10 minutes. There are no seating and you need to enjoy your food outside the compound.

But the burger was absolutely worth it — fresh, tasty and really delicious. A simple place with great vibes and good food!

featured_reviews.name: ASHRAFALI shaik
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very disappointing experience. Despite having a large space, they don’t allow customers to eat at the premises, so everything is forced takeaway and you end up standing outside.

Ordered a chicken roll, chicken patty, chicken lollipop, and eclairs as it was evening and I hadn’t had lunch. Portions were very small and the taste was worse — the chicken roll and chicken patty were sweet with cream inside. Chicken snacks are meant to be savoury, not dessert-like. Since it was parcel-only, there was no chance to even see the food before taking it.

Honestly, it feels like most of their customers are from the nearby Holy Family Hospital who just pick up parcels. Without that location advantage, I doubt the place would survive on food quality alone.

Overall, poor value for money and not worth the hype.

featured_reviews.name: Siddhesh Kotian
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’m extremely disappointed with J Hearsch & Co. in Bandra. Despite being an old and reputed establishment, their quality, service, and overall experience have gone drastically downhill.

To begin with, the staff—especially the owner—were shockingly rude. It’s as if they believe they’re the only bakery that exists just because they’ve been around a while. Sadly, that attitude is exactly why this was my last visit.

Yes, the place has a legacy, but that doesn’t mean you stop upgrading where it matters. Instead of improving service and food quality, they’ve only focused on increasing their prices while everything else has degraded. The quantity has reduced significantly, and the quality is no longer what it used to be.

Here’s what I ordered:
•	Chicken Burger
•	Chicken Samosa
•	Mutton Samosa
•	Mutton Puff
•	Chicken Roll
•	Lime Water

The burger used to come with wafers in a decent box—now it’s wrapped in flimsy paper. The lime water, which once had good quantity for a reasonable price, is now expensive (₹100) and barely enough. Most items were just okay, but not worth the price or the hassle.

There is no seating, no parking, and still, customers are expected to follow a long list of rules. Instead of focusing on unnecessary regulations, they should really work on their customer service, which is currently pathetic.

Honestly, there’s no point in putting in so much effort to visit a place where the staff behaves rudely and the food no longer justifies the hype or price. I won’t be returning, and I certainly won’t recommend this bakery to anyone. Keep your attitude—I’ll take my business elsewhere.
